The '''Executive Verification Suite''' was a document authentication device produced by [[Goseia Heavy Industries Concern/Legends|Goseia Heavy Industries Concern]]. It helped officials detect forged documents as criminals and [[Spy/Legends|spies]] advanced their falsification techniques. Since most [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] lacked the visual acuity to catch subtle inconsistencies, the suite provided electronic verification by identifying official markers used by local governments. However, it sometimes failed to authenticate documents issued by foreign authorities.<ref name="Desperate Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Executive Verification Suite was first mentioned in ''[[Desperate Allies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] supplementary sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' series that was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2015]].<ref name="Desperate Allies" />
